evidence_required: what the utilization counter measures, and two alternative signals with the reason each is better

marking.criterion: utilization.gpu = fraction of sample period with at least one kernel running; says nothing about SMs, tensor use or HBM bandwidth
Signal 1: DCGM DRAM active (bandwidth saturation) plus tensor/SM active, with reason
Signal 2: engine signals (running vs cap, KV usage, waiting queue, step time vs batch), with reason
